answer:
## (a) Descriptives по race-группам (n=12 532 после удаления 154 артефактов grade≥20/95)

| | BLACK (n=1975) | HISPANIC (n=3134) | NON-BLACK/N-HISP (n=7423) |
|---|---|---|---|
| grade 1979, mean±SD | 9.84±2.17 | 10.34±1.88 | 10.71±2.01 |
| % с grade ≥13 | 8.2% | 9.0% | **13.7%** |
| log family net income 1979 | 9.13 | 8.96 | 9.34 |
| ASVAB composite (mean 4 секций) | 441.6 | 421.2 | **510.4** |
| rank percentile (1=bottom) | 0.535 | 0.556 | **0.464** |

Race-градиенты: attainment и academics упорядочены одинаково (black < hispanic < other), income — нет (hisp lowest). Это важно для suppression-паттерна ниже.

## (f) Race-differential missingness — ДО моделей

| Missing | BLACK | HISPANIC | OTHER | gap (pp) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ASVAB | 10.38% | 7.75% | **14.10%** | 6.35 |
| income 1979 | 17.37% | 19.97% | 20.10% | 2.73 |
| rank | 63.95% | 59.99% | 51.60% | 12.35 |

**У тебя был порог 5 п.п. — по ASVAB он превышен (6.35 pp), по rank сильно (12.35 pp).** Направление: у non-black/non-hispanic missing ASVAB больше всего (14.1%), у black меньше (10.4%). Это значит, что complete-case выборка M2 (n=8927, −1144 из 10071, −11.4%) обогащена non-black/non-hispanic относительно raw-доли (59.6%→~61%), и race-коэффициенты в M1/M2 частично отражают composition shift. Income missingness почти симметричен (2.7 pp) — не влияет. Rank subsample (n=4174) — самый смещённый по составу, держу отдельно, как договорились.

## (b) M1 и M2 — полные коэффициенты (OLS, continuous grade; HC1 SE)

**M1** (n=10 071): `grade ~ log_income + black + hisp + female`. R²=0.027.
| var | β | SE | p |
|---|---|---|---|
| log_income | +0.0009 | 0.0196 | 0.963 |
| black | **−0.8607** | 0.0596 | <0.001 |
| hisp | **−0.4086** | 0.0468 | <0.001 |
| female | +0.1969 | 0.0401 | <0.001 |

**M2** (n=8 927): M1 + z_asvab. R²=0.146.
| var | β | SE | p |
|---|---|---|---|
| log_income | **−0.1309** | 0.0201 | <0.001 |
| black | **−0.2548** | 0.0588 | <0.001 |
| hisp | **+0.2788** | 0.0517 | <0.001 |
| female | +0.2272 | 0.0399 | <0.001 |
| z_asvab | **+0.8046** | 0.0245 | <0.001 |

**VIF (M2):** log_income 1.07, black 1.17, hisp 1.31, female 1.00, z_asvab 1.30 — **все < 5, мультиколлинеарности нет**, альтернатива с одной секцией не нужна.

## (c) Δ-таблица (nested: M1 пере-оценён на sample M2, n=8927 — иначе Δ смешан с change of sample)

| var | M1 β | M2 β | Δβ | % attenuation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| black | −0.8256 | −0.2548 | +0.5708 | **69.1%** |
| hisp | −0.4542 | +0.2788 | +0.7330 | **sign flip** (suppression) |
| log_income | −0.0030 (p=0.89) | −0.1309 (p<0.001) | −0.1280 | **от нуля к значимому отрицательному** |

Ключевое: это не чистая аттенуация. ASVAB — доминирующий предиктор (β=0.80 на SD, R² ×5.4), и при его контроле race-эффекты частично «пропускаются» через academics: black аттенуируется на 69%, hispanic меняет знак (классический suppression: у hisp income ниже, но ASVAB между группами — промежуточный), income-эффект **появляется отрицательным** после контроля (suppression в обратную сторону).

## (d) Binary sensitivity (logistic, grade ≥13; base rate 11.7%)

| var | OR M1 (95%CI) | OR M2 (95%CI) | change |
|---|---|---|---|
| log_income | 0.953 [0.904,1.004], p=0.071 | 0.802 [0.759,0.847], p<0.001 | **−15.9%** |
| black | 0.557 [0.461,0.675], p<0.001 | 1.106 [0.887,1.378], **p=0.371 (NS)** | **+98.4% — эффект исчезает** |
| hisp | 0.596 [0.510,0.698], p<0.001 | 1.719 [1.422,2.078], p<0.001 | **+188.1% — sign flip** |
| z_asvab | — | 3.367 [3.079,3.682], p<0.001 | — |

Binary story совпадает с continuous: black-эффект полностью поглощается academics, hisp-эффект переворачивается.

## (e) Rank subsample — ОТДЕЛЬНО (n=4 174, listwise по rank+classsize)

| var | M1r β | M2br β (M1r+asvab+rank) | Δ | % att. |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| log_income | −0.2217*** | −0.2650*** (SE 0.038) | −0.0433 | −19.5% (усиливается) |
| black | −0.4211*** | −0.1773 (p=0.048) | +0.2438 | **57.9%** |
| hisp | −0.5630*** | −0.1731 (p=0.037) | +0.3899 | **69.3%** |
| z_rank | — | −0.0872 (SE 0.036, p=0.016) | — | — |

Отличия от full sample: (1) здесь hisp НЕ переворачивается — sign flip в M2 full sample частично артефакт composition shift от 12% ASVAB-missing у other; (2) income-эффект здесь уже отрицателен ДО academics (−0.22); (3) rank percentile даёт небольшой, но значимый независимый эффект (хуже в классе → ниже attainment, β=−0.087, p=0.016).

## (g) Финальный natural-language hypothesis

> **Hypothesis.** Considering academic characteristics substantially alters the apparent effects of socioeconomic status and race on educational attainment. Using the NLSY79 data, where the outcome must be proxied by "highest grade completed by 1979" (no explicit BA degree-completion variable exists in the file; binary sensitivity uses grade ≥ 13), the raw (unadjusted) associations show large race gaps — Black respondents completed on average 0.86 fewer grade levels (OR 0.56 for reaching grade 13) and Hispanic respondents 0.41 fewer (OR 0.60) than non-black/non-Hispanic peers, while family net income (1979) showed no significant association (β≈0, p=0.96). After adding academic characteristics — an ASVAB composite (1981 z-scores of the four sections, β=0.80 per SD, OR 3.37) and, in the rank subsample, class-rank percentile (β=−0.09, p=0.02) — the Black coefficient attenuates by ~69% (−0.83 → −0.25; OR 0.56 → 1.11, no longer significant), the Hispanic coefficient is fully absorbed and changes sign (−0.45 → +0.28), and the family-income coefficient emerges as significantly negative (β 0.00 → −0.13; OR 0.95 → 0.80), a suppression pattern indicating that income's association with attainment runs largely through academic performance. Thus, academic characteristics are the dominant driver of attainment (R² 0.03 → 0.15), and most of the unadjusted SES and race "effects" are re-attributed to academic performance once it is considered.
>
> **Caveats (part of the answer, not just limitations).** (1) The outcome is a proxy for educational attainment measured in 1979, not actual BA degree completion; a true BA indicator (grade ≥ 16) has only n=39 and is unusable. (2) The academic variables (ASVAB 1981, class rank 1981) are measured AFTER the outcome year, so the attenuation is associational only and cannot be interpreted as causal mediation of BA completion. (3) Missingness is race-differential (ASVAB missing: 10.4% Black, 7.8% Hispanic, 14.1% other; rank missing: 64.0/60.0/51.6%), so complete-case estimates carry a composition bias; the Hispanic sign flip is less robust in the rank subsample (where it remains negative, −0.17), while the Black attenuation (58–69%) is consistent across both samples.

## Workflow

1. Load nls_raw.csv (12 686×61), validate; drop 154 grade artifacts (≥20, e.g. 95.0) → n=12 532.
2. Construct: log1p(family net income 1979); ASVAB composite = mean of 4 sections, z-scored; rank percentile = rank/class size, z-scored; race dummies (black, hispanic; ref=other); female.
3. Pre-model race-differential missingness check (ASVAB 6.35 pp gap > 5 pp threshold → flagged; income 2.73 pp OK; rank 12.35 pp flagged for subsample).
4. M1 OLS (n=10 071) and M1c re-estimated on M2 sample (n=8 927) for a clean nested Δ; M2 = M1 + ASVAB composite; VIF all ≤1.31.
5. Δ table: % attenuation / sign changes per coefficient.
6. Binary logistic sensitivity (grade ≥13): ORs and ΔOR.
7. Rank subsample (n=4 174) separately: M1r → M2br with rank percentile.
8. Hypothesis drafted with explicit proxy + temporal caveats.

**Limitations:** outcome proxy (not BA); temporal reversal (ASVAB 1981 > grade 1979); listwise deletion with race-differential missingness; rank subsample is a biased 33% slice; wealth variables (incl. 1996 "key data point") excluded — they post-date the outcome proxy.

Скрипт: `/workspace/analysis.py` (выполнен, полный лог выше).
